lead_raw_text:
The structure of ScRhB crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with a unit cell containing 12 atoms (Sc4Rh4B4) distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows B centers with eight neighbors (4 Rh, 4 Sc), Rh centers with nine neighbors (3 B, 6 Sc), and Sc centers with a close-packed-like local arrangement of twelve neighbors. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations include corner- and edge-sharing between B and Rh polyhedra, corner-sharing between B and Sc polyhedra, and face-sharing among Sc polyhedra. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites.
